title: Drift outlines a recovery plan for users after $295 million DPRK-linked exploit
summary: The lending protocol proposed tokenized claims, a revenue-backed pool and a security overhaul as it works with law enforcement to recover the stolen funds.

title: Kelp claims that LayerZero approved the setup it blamed for $292 million bridge hack
